title: Equal-amount decoy, closer date — target precision under temptation (AP)
narrative: AP mirror of 009. A EUR 430 supplier bill from Acme Office Supplies (ref AOS-2026-7781). Two outgoing lines are exactly EUR 430: the correct one carries the bill reference and the vendor name; the DECOY is the same amount to a DIFFERENT vendor (Fenno Cleaning) and is two days CLOSER to the bill date. GOLD: auto_match the reference-matching line only. FAILURE TO CATCH: matching the decoy (false target / false-auto-match) or proposing both.
